about: What each format's demo shows, copied from what its JobStep example shows in its app part (examples watched frame by frame at 2 fps, 19 Oct 2026; user: "the demo should show what the example videos show"). Steps run in the app's own order: upload, reading, score, plan, template, color, job, rewriting, review, fit, rescoring, result, cv, download. A step listed here is shown (number = how long it is looked at, ms; reading/rewriting/rescoring = seconds of the sped-up wait); a step not listed happens inside a jump cut. A job step is always a real LinkedIn job link pasted (samples.mjs jobLink). make_scenarios.mjs stretches every look by one pace so the video lasts `seconds`. stop = the demo ends on that step.
